lotteryName: Mitchell-Lama East Midtown Plaza One Bedroom Waiting List - 2026
lotteryDescription: Please click the "More Information" link below for important details. The income limits are according to household composition. The minimum income limit is $25,502, while the maximum is $190,875. The purchase price, which is subject to change, is between $58,774 and $88,609. The monthly maintenance, which is subject to change, is between $638 and $862. There will be a limit of 300 applicants drawn from the lottery. To apply online, click the "Apply Now" link below. To apply by mail, mail a post card or envelope by regular mail to the P.O. Box 158 New York, NY 10272. Registered and certified mail will NOT be accepted. Clearly print your full first and last name, current address, date of birth and the bedroom size lottery you are applying for. Failure to clearly write all information may result in your application not being entered into the lottery. OCCUPANCY STANDARDS: One to Three people. Applicants who live in NYC do not receive a general preference for Mitchell-Lama apartments.
